title: 法兴银行：韩国市场波动剧烈，半导体周期压力显现
speaker: Frank Benzimra

segments.en: Well, Korea is by far the most volatile market, that's very interesting to see that the company now, the semiconductor companies are publishing record earnings, but we are at top margin, and the market is reminding that this market is cyclical, and we have on top of that, and maybe a little bit unlike what we've seen in the US, we have the leverage which is super concentrated on few names.
segments.zh: 韩国是目前波动最大的市场。半导体公司盈利创纪录，但利润率已见顶，市场提醒我们这是周期性行业。此外，杠杆高度集中在少数个股上。

segments.en: So when we put all these, we have this volatility on the market. What to do now about, what's the advice to clients about Korea?
segments.zh: 综合来看，市场波动加剧。那么对韩国市场，给客户的建议是什么？

segments.en: Well, that too, Korea, you have the semiconductor Korea where you have some deleveraging which is happening, which is not being done, and on which we need to be cautious. And then you have the other Korea. You remove the top two semiconductor name, then you have a price to book of 1.5 times, at the time when you have some governance reform, which are happening, and the pretty good level of earnings.
segments.zh: 韩国半导体板块正在去杠杆，但尚未完成，需保持谨慎。而剔除前两大半导体公司后，其余股票市净率仅1.5倍，且伴随治理改革和不错的盈利水平。

segments.en: And I think this is this kind of Korea, that we need to focus on now. Is that going to, do people pay even attention to that? So if you remove the two out of Korea, how much attention do you think people are willing to allocate?
segments.zh: 我认为这才是当前值得关注的韩国市场。剔除两大巨头后，市场还会给予多少关注？
